title: Anonymizing faces and license plates for privacy-preserving
body:
### Checklist

- [X] I've read the [contribution guidelines](https://github.com/autowarefoundation/autoware/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [X] I've searched other issues and no duplicate issues were found.
- [X] I've agreed with the maintainers that I can plan this task.

### Description

In autoware.universe, faces and license plates are not anonymized for privacy-preserving.

### Purpose

Anonymization of faces and license plates to ensure data privacy

### Possible approaches

Read all topics from the bag file and then blur the only image topics. After that write a new bag file that changed new blurred image topics and has the same topics as the previous bag.

### Definition of done

- [ ] Reading bag file with sequential reader
- [ ] Update image topics in bag file with blurred
